name: VEX V5 Mecanum Drive
description: Holonomic VEX V5 drive: 4 x 11 W Smart Motors with green (200 rpm) cartridges, one per 4 in mecanum wheel, direct drive. It can drive sideways and spin while moving; it is easier to push around than a tank drive. Motor numbers are VEX's published ratings; mass and size are typical values, not measurements of one robot.
